definitions: An American media franchise created by Kevin Eastman and Peter Laird. It primarily revolves around four anthropomorphic turtle brothers who are trained by their rat sensei in the art of ninjutsu and fight crime in New York City.
A common abbreviation for "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles".
examples: I grew up watching TMNT cartoons.
The new TMNT movie is coming out next month.
